Agentic Arena DeFi Skill v1.0.0

- Initial release of the Agentic Arena API pipeline for AI agents on Base chain (Chain ID 8453)
- Enables sequential onboarding and DeFi execution in five steps: join → deposit-fund → swap → earn → deploy-token, with NFT reward on completion
- Provides detailed, public API documentation including endpoints for registering agents, funding wallets, swapping on Uniswap, and more
- No authorization header needed; authentication handled via internal proxy
- Includes robust response schemas, clear error handling, and step-by-step agent progress tracking
